Node.id: Unique grid point identifier used by connectivity, loads and constraints.
Node.position1: First coordinate in the position frame. It is x in a rectangular frame and radius in a cylindrical or spherical frame.
Node.position2: Second coordinate in the position frame. It is y in a rectangular frame and an angle in cylindrical or spherical coordinates.
Node.position3: Third coordinate in the position frame. It is z in rectangular and cylindrical coordinates and an angle in spherical coordinates.
Node.permanentConstraints: Component digits fixed at this node in its displacement frame.

SurfaceEdge.node1Id: Grid point at one end of the declared edge.
SurfaceEdge.node2Id: Grid point at the other end of the declared edge.
SurfaceEdge.state: Surface continuation at this edge. Smooth continues the tangent plane, Sharp marks a fold and Raw retains the mesh edge.
SurfaceEdge.elementId: Optional incident element restricting the declaration to its side of the edge.

SurfaceLine.node1Id: First grid point defining the line direction.
SurfaceLine.throughNodeId: Grid point at which the line continues or terminates.
SurfaceLine.node2Id: Next grid point on the line. Omit it to declare a line end.

SurfaceFacet.elementId: Identifier of the existing shell element whose face is declared planar.

PointForceLoad.id: Load-set ID, selected by case control or a load combination.
PointForceLoad.magnitude: Force scale multiplying the three direction components, in force units.
PointForceLoad.frameId: Frame for the force components. Zero uses the basic system.

RodProp.nonStructMass: Additional mass per unit rod length.
RodProp.torsionStressCoefficient: Section factor used in recovering the outer-fibre shear stress from the torsional moment.

IsoMat.density: Mass per unit volume for inertia and gravity loads.
IsoMat.stressFrameId: Coordinate system used for material stress output.

SinglePointConstrList.id: Constraint-set ID selected in case control.
SinglePointConstrList.node: Grid point to which the same component mask is applied.

SolidProp.integration: Selects the integration scheme of solid elements using the property.
SolidProp.stressLocation: Selects the locations where element stresses are recovered.
SolidProp.integrationOrder: Specifies the integration order for the associated solid elements.
SolidProp.elementFunction: Selects the element formulation associated with the property.

AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.synthesize: Selects between an equivalent response derived from tables and directly supplied coefficients.
AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.damping: Equivalent damping per unit surface area.
AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.stiffness: Equivalent stiffness per unit surface area.
AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.mass: Equivalent mass per unit surface area.
AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.resistanceTableId: Table defining the resistive part of the acoustic response.
AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.reactanceTableId: Table defining the reactive part of the acoustic response.
AcousticAbsorberBrickProp.weightingTableId: Optional frequency weighting table used in coefficient synthesis.

DesignVar.id: Identifier referenced by design relations and responses.
DesignVar.entryLabel: Name used to identify the variable in an optimization study.
DesignVar.initialValue: Starting design coordinate. Use the same units for its bounds and discrete values.

ShellProp.nonStructMass: Additional mass per unit shell area.

CompProp.nonStructMass: Additional mass per unit laminate area.

CompPropGlobal.nonStructMass: Additional mass per unit laminate area.

BarProp.nonStructMass: Additional mass per unit bar length.

BeamProp.nonStructMass: Additional mass per unit beam length.

FluidStructureControl.frequency: Number of coupling updates per time step. This is an integer update rate.

GeneralFrame3.matrixForm: Selects whether angles are supplied by equations or by multidimensional tables.
GeneralFrame3.methodName: Rotation convention and axis sequence used to construct the moving frame.

TableMultiVariable0.smoothing: Smoothing option for interpolation along the independent variable.

GeneralMatrix.stiffness: One term in the lower triangle of the stiffness matrix. Terms are ordered down each column.
GeneralMatrix.flexibility: One term in the lower triangle of the compliance matrix. Terms are ordered down each column.
GeneralMatrix.dependencyMatrix: Coefficient relating the independent set to the dependent set. This matrix is entered by rows.

UserFileName.entryName: File name or path associated with this file identifier.

Rod2.node1: First endpoint of the rod. The vector from node1 to node2 defines its local axial direction.
Rod2.node2: Second endpoint of the rod. Its distance from node1 is the undeformed element length.
